title: Hierarchical Bayesian physics-augmented neural networks for populations of hyperelastic laws: specimen variability and uncertainty from scarce, noisy data
abstract: arXiv:2611.17892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The hyperelastic law of a material such as soft tissue differs between specimens, and often only a few specimens can be tested. Physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) learn such laws from data without a prescribed functional form while keeping them physically admissible, and Bayesian versions of related models quantify the uncertainty of the law of one specimen or of a pooled group of specimens. A pooled fit, however, attributes the differences between specimens to measurement noise or to uncertainty about a mean law, and neither describes a new specimen. We first develop a Bayesian PANN for one specimen, whose priors keep the learned law plausible for few, noisy data. We then extend it to a hierarchical Bayesian PANN, a nonlinear mixed-effects model in which all specimens share learned polyconvex features and each specimen is a draw from a population of laws. translated_title: 面向超弹性本构模型群体的分层贝叶斯物理增强神经网络：从稀疏、含噪数据中获取样本间变异性与不确定性
translated_abstract: 软组织等材料的超弹性本构关系在不同样本之间存在差异，而通常只能对少数样本进行测试。物理增强神经网络（PANNs）能够在不预设函数形式的情况下从数据中学习此类本构关系，同时保持其物理合理性；相关的贝叶斯模型版本则可量化单个样本或一组汇集样本的本构模型的不确定性。然而，汇集拟合会将样本之间的差异归因于测量噪声或对平均本构模型的不确定性，这两者都无法描述一个新的样本。我们首先针对单个样本开发了一种贝叶斯PANN，其先验设计保证了在数据稀少且含噪的情况下所学到的本构关系仍然物理合理。随后，我们将其扩展为分层贝叶斯PANN，即一种非线性混合效应模型：所有样本共享学习得到的多凸特征，而每个样本则是从本构模型总体中抽取的一个样本。特征、样本与总体通过变分推断进行联合推断……
tldr: 提出一种分层贝叶斯物理增强神经网络（非线性混合效应模型），可从稀疏、含噪数据中联合推断软组织等材料超弹性本构模型的群体分布、各样本个体差异及其不确定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a hierarchical Bayesian physics-augmented neural network (a nonlinear mixed-effects model) that jointly infers the population of hyperelastic laws, specimen-level variability, and uncertainty from scarce, noisy data.
